train_base_trainer: train a deep learning model using BaseTrainer with data loaders, model, and config
create_optimizer_adamw: create an AdamW or Adam optimizer with separate weight decay for bias and weight parameters
resume_training_from_checkpoint: resume training from a saved checkpoint restoring model, optimizer, and scheduler states
save_model_checkpoint: save a model checkpoint with epoch, iteration, best error, and optimizer state
validate_model_with_ground_truth: validate a trained model against ground truth data at specified epoch intervals
